name: paste-once
title: Paste Once
description: Flatten a copied multi-line shell snippet into one pasteable command. Also strips tracking from URLs, joins hard-wrapped markdown, and previews markdown as formatted text.
author: mikolaj_pietkiewicz

commands.name: paste-trimmed
commands.title: Paste Trimmed
commands.subtitle: Paste Once
commands.description: Flatten the clipboard as a shell command and paste it into the frontmost app.

commands.name: copy-trimmed
commands.title: Copy Trimmed
commands.subtitle: Paste Once
commands.description: Flatten the clipboard as a shell command and copy the result.

commands.name: clean-url
commands.title: Clean URL
commands.subtitle: Paste Once
commands.description: Strip tracking query parameters from a typed or copied URL, then copy the result.

commands.name: render-markdown
commands.title: Render Markdown
commands.subtitle: Paste Once
commands.description: Preview copied markdown as formatted text, then copy or paste it into apps that do not read markdown.

commands.name: reflow-markdown
commands.title: Reflow Markdown
commands.subtitle: Paste Once
commands.description: Join hard-wrapped markdown from the clipboard while keeping headings, lists, blank lines, and fenced code.

preferences.name: aggressiveness
preferences.title: Sensitivity
preferences.description: How eagerly multi-line text is treated as a shell command. These commands only run when you invoke them, so High is the default.

preferences.name: preserveBlankLines
preferences.title: Cleanup
preferences.description: Keep blank lines when flattening a command.
preferences.label: Preserve blank lines

preferences.name: removeBoxDrawing
preferences.description: Strip box-drawing gutter characters copied from terminal output.
preferences.label: Remove box-drawing characters

preferences.name: flattenClaudeCodePrompts
preferences.description: Flatten Claude Code prompt decorations and wrapped slash commands.
preferences.label: Flatten Claude Code prompts

preferences.name: extraUrlKeepRules
preferences.title: Extra URL Keep Rules
preferences.description: Additional content-identity query params. One rule per line: domain.com: param1, param2

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the prepublishOnly script and rerun "npm publish" to proceed.
If you didn't, you were likely trying to publish the extension to the Raycast Store.

Use "npm run publish" instead of "npm publish".


" && exit 1
